name: ANCFZ V2 | 04 | Package quote + development PDF

nodes.name: Receive Node Dispatch
nodes.notes: The workflow is internal-only in Compose. The Node execute boundary rechecks the approved action, Lead, package, quote and PDF integrity.

parameters.jsCode: const input=$json.body??$json; const headers=$json.headers??{}; const secret=headers['x-agentic-internal-secret']??headers['X-Agentic-Internal-Secret']; if(secret !== $env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET) throw new Error('Internal dispatch authentication failed.'); const uuid=v=>typeof v==='string'&&/^[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f-]{27,}$/i.test(v); for(const k of ['actionId','tenantId','sessionId']) if(!uuid(input[k])) throw new Error('Missing server-issued '+k); if(input.workflowKey!=="package.confirm"||input.contract!=="ancfz-local-quote-pdf-v1") throw new Error('Unsupported package quote contract.'); return [{json:{actionId:input.actionId,tenantId:input.tenantId,sessionId:input.sessionId,workflowKey:input.workflowKey,contract:input.contract}}];

nodes.name: Create Quote and Verify PDF
nodes.notes: Development-only Node boundary. It returns verified PDF metadata only after hashing the downloaded artifact.

notes: Development-only local quote workflow. It must remain disabled outside the private local Compose profile and must not be treated as an official ANCFZ quote provider.
